scenes.narration: On big multiplications, the older model got none right. Gemini 4 Hydrogen got forty-eight of fifty.

scenes.narration: Take one ten-digit pair. The older model failed after four digits. Hydrogen got all twenty.

scenes.visual_objective: One ten-digit pair, digit by digit

scenes.narration: We gave both models the same ninety multiplications, from two digits to ten, and code checked every digit.

scenes.visual_objective: Ninety multiplications, same problems, code checked

scenes.narration: Up to five digits, Hydrogen was perfect. The older model, twenty-seven.
